name: CourtFilingPreparationConsole
tagline: Format rules, checklists, partner sign-off and e-filing status for every court document – in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete litigation filing desk for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages. Each filing type gets its own page and word limits, font and spacing rules and checklist; a drafter–partner–client sign-off chain gates Ready to file; the e-filing view records submission, registry acceptance or rejection, re-filing and service, with deadlines, the court cut-off, fees and the acceptance SLA flagged.
features: Checklist per filing type with readiness %
Drafter → partner → client sign-off chain with four-eyes rule
Sign-offs cleared when the document changes
Allowed stage transitions with reasons and undo
E-filing reference, fee, acceptance SLA, rejection and re-file count
Service date and method, filed-late detection
Bulk assign filer, mark fee paid, CSV export
Demo mode with fictional sample data
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (2 controls: niray_Niray.CourtFilingPreparationConsole data-set; niray_Niray.CourtFilingPreparationConsolePortal field control)
